App.Title: Wayfinder
App.Subtitle: Guided PF2E creation and level-up
App.NoPending: No Wayfinder-guided steps are pending. PF2E-native or manual choices may still live on the character sheet.
App.FeedbackAria: Feedback — report a problem or suggest an idea
App.FeedbackTooltip: Report a problem or suggest an idea
App.Guidance: Wayfinder handles the picks — ancestry, feats, class branches, spells. Ability boosts and skill increases are walked through here too. Anything Wayfinder can't model cleanly hands off to your character sheet.

Feedback.Title: Wayfinder feedback
Feedback.Heading: Tell me what happened
Feedback.Intro: Two ways to reach me. Pick whichever sounds closer — I'd rather get a rough report than none at all.
Feedback.ExternalTitle: These go to GitHub, and they're public
Feedback.ExternalBody: You'll need a free GitHub account to post, and anyone can read what you write. Opens in a new browser tab.
Feedback.BugHint: Something did the wrong thing, or nothing at all.
Feedback.FeatureHint: Something that would make building easier.
Feedback.Prefill: Your Wayfinder, Foundry, and PF2E versions are filled in for you.
Feedback.Privacy: Screenshots often catch player names and your world's invite link — worth a look before you post.
Feedback.CoverageHint: — a step Wayfinder hands back to the PF2E sheet may simply not be covered yet.

ExtraPacks.Name: Extra PF2E compendium allowlist
ExtraPacks.Hint: Comma-separated compendium ids or wildcards to search in addition to the official PF2E packs. Use my-module.* for every compendium in one module, or * for every installed compendium.

SpellRarityCeiling.Name: Player max eligible rarity
SpellRarityCeiling.Hint: Spells up to this rarity appear without a per-step attestation. For higher rarities, players must record character or rules Access, or GM permission reported by the player, unless Unique is selected. This record is not verified GM authorization. Tradition, rank, cantrip, curriculum, and fixed spell restrictions still apply.

Notifications.OwnerOnly: Only the character's owner can use Wayfinder on this sheet.
Notifications.MissingSelections: Finish the remaining steps before applying.
Notifications.NoPendingSteps: There are no Wayfinder-guided steps to apply. Check the PF2E sheet for any native or manual choices.
Notifications.DuplicateSelections: You can't pick the same option twice in one draft.
Notifications.ApplyCancelled: Apply cancelled — your draft is still here.
Notifications.ApplyFailed: Couldn't apply the changes. Your draft is intact — review and try again.
